name: private_flags
evidence: Unit::CanDoubleOn(const Unit*) const 0x0052B670: ORed with Person.flags and Job.flags (both PersonFlag words) and tested against the no-pair PrivateSkill bit

name: state_flags
evidence: Unit::DoubleOn(Unit*) 0x003D82C0 sets bit 1 (2) on the lead and bit 2 (4) on the partner, DoubleOff clears them; map::Sequence ProcSequence::TurnBegin 0x003A557C clears bit 23 (0x800000) instead of taking a gauge point (meaning of bit 23 from that use: the unit fought); other bits not traced

name: next
evidence: Unit::GetNext(unsigned int) const 0x00533208 returns this word when it is not 0 (next unit of the same force); Awakening had it at +0xC

name: conditions
evidence: condition bytes: Unit::GetAvoid 0x00533780 takes 20 off avoid for bit 1 of byte 0; Unit::GetStrImpl 0x0052A9C4 / GetPowImpl halve the stat for bit 6 / 7 of byte 0; the five stat getters add rally and tonic amounts for single bits of bytes 1 .. 4 and +2 / -1 for bits of byte 4 or 5; map::BattleInfo::Side::GetSimpleTimes 0x00525AA0 gives no strike with a magic weapon for bit 3 of byte 0 (what sets each bit: not traced)

name: absorbed
evidence: per stat: added by Unit::GetStrImpl 0x0052AA48 (+0x30), GetPowImpl (+0x31), GetTechImpl (+0x32), GetQuickImpl (+0x33), GetLuckImpl (+0x34) when the unit has that stat's 'absorb' skill (the SEID '<stat> absorb' skills); the hp element is not read

name: debuff
evidence: per stat: subtracted by the five stat getters (GetStrImpl 0x0052AB24 reads +0x38 for str ...) when their third argument is set; the hp element is not read

name: ai_arguments
evidence: AIValue::GetArgument(AIValue::Order::Type,Unit*) const 0x00543E0C returns unit + 0x6A + 2 * (order * 4 + variable): sixteen s16, four per order (Awakening: ai_variables at +0x3C)

name: person
evidence: Unit::GetDualSupport 0x0052E984 and Unit::GetDoubleCapability read the Person record through it (Person.family_index +0x2A, attack/guard_stance_bonus +0x1C/+0x20); config/tables/slots.csv

name: job
evidence: Unit::GetDoubleMovePower 0x00530680 and Unit::GetDoubleCapability 0x00530A88 read Job.pair_up (+0x3C) through it

name: force
evidence: Unit::GetNext 0x00533220 loads this pointer and reads Force.type (+0x8) to continue with the next force

name: pair_partner
evidence: Unit::DoubleOn(Unit*) 0x003D82C0 stores each unit into the other's word; DoubleOff clears both; map::BattleInfo::CalculateDual 0x003473D4 compares it with the side's dual unit

name: edit
evidence: Unit::GetDualSupport 0x0052EA04 passes this record's +0x1A/+0x1B to PersonEnhanceDual::GetEdit; 0 for a unit without avatar choices

name: family
evidence: Unit::GetDualSupport 0x0052E9A0 and Unit::GetDoubleCapability use unit::Family::GetDualSupport/GetDoubleCapability on it when it and its +0x0/+0x14 words are not 0

name: growth_seed
evidence: Unit::LevelUp(void) 0x003D8160 seeds a Random from this word (Random::Initialize) and stores the generator's next value back here at 0x003D8178 before rolling; each level-up starts from it (docs/GROWTH.md)

name: gains
evidence: per-stat gains G[s] (docs/TABLES.md): the five stat getters add +0xC8 + stat (GetStrImpl 0x0052A984 reads +0xC9)

name: limit_bonus
evidence: Unit::GetLimit(int) 0x0053384C adds the s8 at +0xD0 + stat to the stat cap

name: stat_loss
evidence: the five stat getters subtract +0xE0 + stat (GetStrImpl 0x0052A998 reads +0xE1) from the base stat before the cap while state bit 30 (0x40000000) is set (what sets it: not traced)

name: weapon_exp
evidence: Unit::GetWeaponExp(ItemKind::Type) const 0x0052DC5C reads the byte at unit + 0xE8 + kind and caps it with Unit::GetWeaponExpLimit; Unit::GetHit 0x00532F94 and Unit::GetAttack 0x00534260 read it the same way (one byte per weapon kind)

name: level
evidence: Unit::LevelUp 0x003D8174 adds 1; GrowSequence::LevelUp 0x001B48CC compares it with the copy's; Unit::GetLevelForCalculateExp 0x00531F80 and Unit::ExpNormalize 0x0052D394 read it

name: exp
evidence: Unit::ExpNormalize(int) 0x0052D3A4: exp + the amount is compared with 100 (a level-up) and the amount is cut to 100 - exp at the last level

name: map_x
evidence: AIThink::IsMoveOver(Unit*,int,int) 0x004C855C ldrsb and compares with x (Awakening +0x90)

name: map_y
evidence: AIThink::IsMoveOver(Unit*,int,int) 0x004C8568 ldrsb and compares with y (Awakening +0x91)

name: equip_skills
evidence: Unit::IsEquipSkill(short) const 0x0052DD30 compares the s16 at +0xFE, +0x100 .. +0x106 (after the personal skill) with the skill; Unit::GetHasEquipSkillNum 0x00530B98 counts the u16 slots that are not 0 (five equipped skills, 0 = empty)

name: items
evidence: the five carried unit::Item (u16 item number, u16 flags; flag 0x4000 = equipped): Unit::GetItemIndexEquipped 0x005310C0 tests the u16 at +0x10A + 4 * slot; Unit::GetHit(int,bool) 0x00532DAC passes unit + 0x108 + 4 * slot

name: exp_level_offset
evidence: Unit::GetLevelForCalculateExp 0x00531F8C adds this s8 to the level (meaning of the value not traced)

name: level_limit_raises
evidence: Unit::GetLimitLevel 0x0052E620 and Unit::ExpNormalize 0x0052D388 add it times the word at 0x006D96E4 to the class level limit (when the limit is above 20 or the class is promoted); Unit::LevelUp 0x003D8270 compares it with Person.level_cap

name: exp_decline
evidence: Unit::GetExpDamage 0x0052D550: on difficulty 2 and above the other unit's byte minus 2 (at least 0) is taken off the experience; what sets it: not traced

name: guard_gauge
evidence: this unit's part of the pair's shield gauge: map::BattleInfo::CalculateDual 0x003473F4 adds the lead's and the partner's; BattleCalculator::InitializeProgress 0x00362844 copies it per side; ProcSequence::UpdateHp 0x0035C8E4 stores the fight's counter back; TurnBegin 0x003A55A0 takes 1 off
